_comment: Trigger registry for githooks/post-commit and post-merge. Add an entry to wire a new commit-message keyword to your own script; the hook logic never changes. Keep githooks/_lib.sh's _use_defaults() in sync — a test asserts they match.
_watchGlobsComment: Paths whose ADDITION, DELETION, or RENAME auto-triggers every generator. Modifications do not — a content-only edit should use the commit-message keyword instead. Both app/ and src/app/ are listed because either may be the real one; a non-matching pathspec simply yields nothing.
